subtopics.title: Solar photovoltaic
subtopics.scope: Crystalline silicon, thin-film, perovskite and tandem PV cells and modules, their efficiency, manufacturing, costs, degradation, and deployment at utility and rooftop scale (perovskite and tandem cells are pre-commercial/early-commercial; durability is still contested).

subtopics.title: Concentrated solar power and solar thermal
subtopics.scope: Parabolic trough, power tower, Fresnel and dish systems, with molten-salt and other heat storage, plus solar thermal heating for water and space heating (CSP cost competitiveness versus PV is disputed).

subtopics.title: Wind energy (onshore, offshore, airborne and high-altitude)
subtopics.scope: Horizontal and vertical axis turbines, floating and fixed offshore foundations, and airborne/high-altitude wind systems (kite and tethered-aircraft designs are pre-commercial and their grid-scale viability is contested).

subtopics.title: Conventional and run-of-river hydropower, including low-head, micro and pumped storage
subtopics.scope: Reservoir dams, run-of-river, low-head and micro hydro, and pumped storage hydro, covering ecological and social impacts and capacity factors.

subtopics.title: Marine energy: tidal range, tidal stream, wave, and wave-powered and marine hybrids
subtopics.scope: Tidal barrages and lagoons, tidal turbines, oscillating-body and oscillating-water-column wave devices, and wave-wind-aquaculture hybrids (most are pre-commercial; tidal lagoon viability is disputed).

subtopics.title: Ocean thermal, salinity gradient and hydrokinetic/river current energy
subtopics.scope: OTEC (closed, open and hybrid cycles), pressure-retarded and reverse-electrodialysis osmotic power, and river and hydrokinetic turbines (OTEC and osmotic power are pre-commercial and contested on economics).

subtopics.title: Geothermal energy (hydrothermal, enhanced and heat pumps)
subtopics.scope: Hydrothermal flash and binary plants, enhanced geothermal systems including closed-loop and superhot rock concepts (EGS is pre-commercial; induced seismicity is disputed), and ground-source heat pumps.

subtopics.title: Bioenergy: biomass, biogas, liquid biofuels, algae and municipal waste
subtopics.scope: Biomass combustion and co-firing, anaerobic digestion and biogas, first- and second-generation liquid biofuels, advanced and algae biofuels (algae at scale is pre-commercial), and waste-to-energy from municipal solid waste, including land-use and sustainability debates.

subtopics.title: Bioenergy with carbon capture and storage (BECCS) and carbon-negative bioenergy
subtopics.scope: Capture of CO2 from biomass combustion, fermentation and biogas upgrading, transport and storage, with life-cycle carbon accounting and feasibility debates (largely pre-commercial at scale).

subtopics.title: Nuclear fission: conventional, small modular and advanced reactors
subtopics.scope: Light-water and heavy-water reactors, SMRs, molten salt, fast breeder, and thorium-cycle designs, covering safety, waste, fuel supply and cost; advanced designs are pre-commercial and their classification as renewable is contested.

subtopics.title: Nuclear fusion: magnetic and inertial confinement
subtopics.scope: Tokamaks, stellarators, laser inertial fusion and magnetised target fusion, covering scientific and engineering milestones and the commercial timeline (all pre-commercial and speculative as energy sources).

subtopics.title: Hydrogen production pathways
subtopics.scope: Electrolysis (alkaline, PEM, solid oxide), thermochemical water splitting, nuclear-assisted high-temperature electrolysis, and photocatalytic or biological hydrogen (several are pre-commercial).

subtopics.title: Natural (geologic/white) hydrogen
subtopics.scope: Subsurface hydrogen accumulations and serpentinization-driven production, exploration status, extraction feasibility, and whether it qualifies as a primary energy source (speculative and contested).

subtopics.title: Energy storage: batteries, thermal, hydrogen and mechanical
subtopics.scope: Lithium-ion and flow batteries, thermal energy storage, hydrogen storage and fuel cells, compressed air and gravity storage, covering duration, cost and efficiency (gravity storage and advanced flow chemistries are pre-commercial).

subtopics.title: Space-based solar power
subtopics.scope: Orbital solar collection and microwave or laser power beaming to Earth, covering technical feasibility, launch cost dependencies and demonstrations (pre-commercial and speculative).

subtopics.title: Grid integration, smart grids and power electronics
subtopics.scope: Transmission and HVDC, grid-scale power electronics, inverters, smart grid control, forecasting and curtailment management, covering the integration of variable renewables.

subtopics.title: Demand response, virtual power plants and microgrids
subtopics.scope: Demand-side flexibility, aggregated distributed resources operating as virtual power plants, and islanded or community microgrids, covering market design and reliability.

subtopics.title: Cross-cutting: lifecycle, materials, land use and policy
subtopics.scope: Life-cycle emissions, material criticality, recycling and decommissioning, land and ocean-use conflicts, and cost and policy frameworks that apply across technologies (added as a missing cross-cutting area).

omittedOnPurpose: Nothing deliberately excluded. Debated or pre-commercial candidates (airborne wind, tidal lagoons, OTEC, osmotic power, EGS, superhot rock, natural hydrogen, space-based solar, fusion, advanced fission, algae biofuels, BECCS, gravity storage, perovskite PV) are included with caveats in their scopes. Cross-cutting policy and lifecycle topics are included as a separate subtopic rather than omitted.

subtopics.title: Solar photovoltaic
subtopics.scope: Covers crystalline silicon, thin-film, and emerging PV cell technologies (perovskite, tandem, organic, quantum dot), their efficiency, cost, degradation, and deployment at utility and rooftop scale.

subtopics.title: Concentrated solar power
subtopics.scope: Covers parabolic trough, power tower, linear Fresnel and dish systems, their thermal storage integration, and their deployment economics.

subtopics.title: Solar thermal heating
subtopics.scope: Covers flat-plate and evacuated-tube collectors for water and space heating, plus solar process heat for industry.

subtopics.title: Onshore and offshore wind
subtopics.scope: Covers turbine design, fixed-bottom and floating offshore wind, wind resource assessment, and grid-scale deployment. Airborne and high-altitude wind (kites, tethered systems, balloons) is a pre-commercial sub-case included with the caveat that it is not yet commercially deployed at scale.

subtopics.title: Hydroelectric power (conventional, run-of-river, pumped storage)
subtopics.scope: Covers reservoir dams, run-of-river schemes, pumped-storage hydro as both generation and storage, and their environmental and sediment impacts.

subtopics.title: Marine energy: tidal stream, tidal range, wave
subtopics.scope: Covers tidal stream turbines, tidal barrage and lagoon schemes, and wave energy converters, including their pre-commercial status and grid connection challenges.

subtopics.title: Ocean thermal, salinity gradient, and other ocean-derived sources
subtopics.scope: Covers OTEC (closed, open, hybrid cycles) and salinity-gradient (pressure-retarded and reverse-electrodialysis osmosis) energy, with caveat that both are pre-commercial with few or no full-scale plants. Also covers ocean current and marine biomass proposals where relevant, flagged as speculative.

subtopics.title: Geothermal energy
subtopics.scope: Covers hydrothermal flash and binary plants, enhanced geothermal systems (EGS), direct-use heat, and induced seismicity risks; EGS is flagged as partly pre-commercial.

subtopics.title: Bioenergy: solid biomass, biogas, and waste-to-energy
subtopics.scope: Covers biomass combustion and co-firing, anaerobic digestion and biogas upgrading, landfill gas, and municipal solid waste incineration, including sustainability and land-use debates over whether these are truly renewable or long-term sustainable.

subtopics.title: Liquid biofuels (first and advanced generation)
subtopics.scope: Covers ethanol, biodiesel, HVO, sustainable aviation fuel, and advanced cellulosic and algal biofuels, with the caveat that algal biofuels remain largely pre-commercial and food-versus-fuel debates apply.

subtopics.title: Hydrogen production and fuel cells
subtopics.scope: Covers green hydrogen by electrolysis, low-carbon hydrogen from natural gas with CCS and methane pyrolysis, hydrogen storage, and fuel cell technologies (PEM, SOFC, etc.); note hydrogen is an energy carrier rather than a primary source, a point of dispute.

subtopics.title: Nuclear fission: conventional, SMR and advanced reactors
subtopics.scope: Covers Gen III/III+ light-water reactors, small modular reactors, and advanced fission (fast reactors, molten salt, high-temperature gas, thorium cycles); SMR and advanced designs flagged as pre-commercial and contested under renewable definitions.

subtopics.title: Nuclear fusion
subtopics.scope: Covers magnetic confinement (tokamaks, stellarators) and inertial confinement (laser ignition, NIF) approaches, and private-sector fusion programs; flagged as not yet demonstrated for net electricity production and contested as a renewable or sustainable source.

subtopics.title: Space-based solar power and other speculative sources
subtopics.scope: Covers orbital solar collection with microwave or laser transmission to Earth, and lunar or other unconventional proposals; flagged as speculative and pre-commercial with no operational demonstration at utility scale.

subtopics.title: Electricity storage: batteries and long-duration storage
subtopics.scope: Covers lithium-ion, sodium-ion, flow batteries, compressed air (CAES and advanced adiabatic), gravity storage, and hydrogen-based storage for multi-day or seasonal balancing.

subtopics.title: Thermal energy storage
subtopics.scope: Covers molten salt, phase-change materials, packed bed, and underground thermal storage used with CSP, district heating, and buildings.

subtopics.title: Grid integration, transmission, and smart grids
subtopics.scope: Covers HVDC and HVAC transmission, interconnectors, grid-forming inverters, forecasting, curtailment, smart meters, and demand response and virtual power plants.

subtopics.title: Power-to-X and synthetic fuels
subtopics.scope: Covers e-fuels such as e-methane, e-methanol, e-ammonia, and Fischer-Tropsch synthetic fuels produced from renewable electricity plus captured CO2, and their role in hard-to-electrify sectors.

subtopics.title: Carbon capture and storage for bioenergy (BECCS) and direct air capture linkage
subtopics.scope: Covers BECCS and biomass-with-CCS as negative-emission pathways, and the CCS infrastructure they depend on; flagged as contested because it depends on sustainable biomass supply.

subtopics.title: Cross-cutting: lifecycle, materials, and resource constraints
subtopics.scope: Covers lifecycle emissions, land use, critical minerals, recycling of panels and blades, and resource-availability limits across all technologies; this is a missing cross-cutting area that the first pass did not cover.

omittedOnPurpose: Not omitted: all debated items are kept as subtopics with caveats. Strictly excluded: general fossil fuel technologies and fossil-with-CCS, which fall outside the requester's scope. Economic policy, subsidies, and market design are not technologies and are left to be handled outside this decomposition unless the requester asks for them.

subtopics.title: Wind energy (onshore, offshore, airborne and kite/tethered systems)
subtopics.scope: Covers conventional horizontal-axis turbines onshore and offshore (fixed and floating), plus airborne wind energy and kite/tethered systems, with caveat that airborne and kite systems are pre-commercial and unproven at grid scale.

subtopics.title: Hydropower (conventional, run-of-river, small hydro, pumped storage)
subtopics.scope: Covers reservoir dams, run-of-river and small hydro, and pumped-storage hydro as both generation and storage, including ecological and displacement impacts.

subtopics.title: Marine energy (tidal range, tidal stream, wave, ocean current and deep-water)
subtopics.scope: Covers tidal barrages and lagoons, tidal stream and marine current turbines, wave energy converters, and ocean current and deep-water renewables, with caveat that most wave and deep-water concepts are pre-commercial.

subtopics.title: Ocean thermal energy conversion and salinity gradient energy
subtopics.scope: Covers OTEC (closed, open and hybrid cycles) and osmotic/pressure-retarded osmosis and reverse electrodialysis, with caveat that both are pre-commercial and OTEC economics are contested.

subtopics.title: Geothermal energy (hydrothermal, EGS, hot dry rock, superhot, heat pumps)
subtopics.scope: Covers hydrothermal resources, enhanced geothermal systems, hot dry rock and superhot rock concepts, and ground-source heat pumps, with caveat that EGS and superhot rock are pre-commercial and induced seismicity is disputed.

subtopics.title: Bioenergy (biomass combustion, biogas, liquid biofuels, solid biomass and waste-to-energy)
subtopics.scope: Covers biomass co-firing and dedicated combustion, anaerobic digestion and biogas/biomethane, ethanol, biodiesel, advanced biofuels and SAF, and municipal solid waste incineration, including land-use and sustainability disputes.

subtopics.title: Hydrogen production, storage, transport and fuel cells
subtopics.scope: Covers electrolysis, green, blue and other hydrogen routes, hydrogen storage and transport, and fuel cell technologies, with caveat that the efficiency and emissions status of blue hydrogen is contested.

subtopics.title: Nuclear fission (conventional, SMRs and advanced reactors)
subtopics.scope: Covers current light-water and heavy-water reactors, small modular reactors, Generation IV designs, and their safety, waste and cost debates; caveat that SMRs and advanced designs are largely pre-commercial and whether nuclear counts as renewable is disputed.

subtopics.title: Thorium and molten-salt reactors
subtopics.scope: Covers thorium fuel cycles, liquid fluoride and other molten-salt reactor designs, with caveat that these are pre-commercial, have few operating prototypes, and their classification as renewable or sustainable is disputed.

subtopics.title: Nuclear fusion (magnetic and inertial confinement)
subtopics.scope: Covers tokamaks, stellarators, laser inertial confinement and magneto-inertial approaches and their path to net energy, with caveat that fusion is speculative as a commercial source and its inclusion as renewable is disputed.

subtopics.title: Space-based solar power
subtopics.scope: Covers orbital solar collection, wireless power beaming, and ground reception, with caveat that the technology is speculative and pre-commercial with unresolved cost and transmission feasibility.

subtopics.title: Artificial photosynthesis and solar fuels
subtopics.scope: Covers photoelectrochemical and biological-hybrid routes producing fuels directly from sunlight, CO2 and water, with caveat that these are laboratory-stage and pre-commercial.

subtopics.title: Floating solar and offshore PV
subtopics.scope: Covers floating PV on reservoirs and lakes, and offshore PV installations, with caveat that offshore PV is pre-commercial at scale.

subtopics.title: Energy storage (batteries, compressed air, thermal, flywheels, hydrogen carriers)
subtopics.scope: Covers electrochemical batteries, compressed air energy storage, thermal storage, flywheels, and long-duration storage technologies.

subtopics.title: Grid integration, power electronics, transmission and HVDC
subtopics.scope: Covers smart grids, grid-following and grid-forming inverters, power electronics, transmission expansion and HVDC interconnection, and grid stability with high variable renewable shares.

subtopics.title: Demand response, virtual power plants and electrification
subtopics.scope: Covers demand-side flexibility, aggregated virtual power plants, electrification of transport and heat, and heat pump deployment at building and district scale.

subtopics.title: Carbon capture linked to energy systems (BECCS and direct air capture)
subtopics.scope: Covers bioenergy with carbon capture and storage and direct air capture coupled to energy systems, with caveat that these are pre-commercial at scale and their net-negative potential is disputed.

subtopics.title: Policy, siting, lifecycle and material supply chains
subtopics.scope: Covers renewable policy instruments, land and marine siting and permitting, lifecycle emissions, critical minerals and recycling, and labor and supply-chain issues across all technologies.

omittedOnPurpose: Fossil fuel-based technologies, including fossil with CCS, are excluded by the scope. Ambient micro-harvesting is noted as missing but is not given a separate subtopic beyond the policy/lifecycle coverage, because it does not function as a long-term primary energy source at grid scale; it can be added if the requester wants it.

subtopics.title: Solar photovoltaic
subtopics.scope: Crystalline silicon, thin-film (CdTe, CIGS), perovskite and tandem, organic PV and building-integrated PV; efficiency, cost, deployment, and degradation. Caveat: perovskite and tandem cells are pre-commercial with stability issues.

subtopics.title: Concentrated solar power and solar thermal (heating and cooling)
subtopics.scope: Parabolic trough, power tower, dish systems with thermal storage; solar water heating, solar space heating, solar cooling and desalination-linked thermal uses. Caveat: CSP has a contested cost position versus PV and batteries.

subtopics.title: Solar fuels and photosynthetic conversion
subtopics.scope: Artificial photosynthesis, photoelectrochemical water splitting, solar-driven CO2 reduction, and natural photosynthesis harvested for fuel. Caveat: almost entirely pre-commercial, low efficiency and durability.

subtopics.title: Wind energy: onshore, offshore, and airborne/high-altitude
subtopics.scope: Turbine design, floating offshore wind, and airborne wind energy systems (kites, tethered drones, high-altitude wind power). Caveat: airborne and high-altitude wind energy are pre-commercial with few full-scale deployments.

subtopics.title: Hydropower: conventional, run-of-river, and pumped storage
subtopics.scope: Reservoir and run-of-river hydro, and pumped storage hydro as an enabling storage system; environmental and ecological impacts included. Caveat: sustainability as renewable is disputed due to methane emissions from reservoirs and ecological harm.

subtopics.title: Ocean and marine energy: tidal, wave, OTEC, osmotic, currents, marine biomass and hybrids
subtopics.scope: Tidal stream and tidal range, wave energy converters, ocean thermal energy conversion, salinity gradient (osmotic/PRO/RED) power, ocean current turbines, marine biomass, and ocean/marine hybrid systems. Caveat: tidal range, OTEC, osmotic power, and wave energy are mostly pre-commercial or demonstration-stage.

subtopics.title: Geothermal energy: hydrothermal, enhanced geothermal, superhot rock
subtopics.scope: Conventional hydrothermal, enhanced geothermal systems (EGS), closed-loop geothermal, and superhot rock (supercritical) geothermal; drilling and induced seismicity. Caveat: EGS and superhot rock are pre-commercial; induced seismicity is a contested risk.

subtopics.title: Bioenergy: biomass, biofuels, biogas, anaerobic digestion, and waste-to-energy
subtopics.scope: Solid biomass combustion and co-firing, first/second/third-generation biofuels, biogas and anaerobic digestion, and municipal and industrial waste-to-energy incineration and gasification. Caveat: biomass carbon neutrality and land-use impacts are disputed; waste-to-energy classification as renewable varies by jurisdiction.

subtopics.title: Algae-based energy
subtopics.scope: Microalgae biofuels, algal biogas, and algal biomass for energy; cultivation economics and scale-up. Caveat: pre-commercial; commercial viability is contested.

subtopics.title: Bioenergy with carbon capture and storage (BECCS)
subtopics.scope: Combining biomass energy or biofuel production with carbon capture and geological storage to create net negative emissions. Caveat: speculative at scale; dependent on biomass sustainability and storage assumptions.

subtopics.title: Nuclear fission: conventional, small modular, and advanced reactors
subtopics.scope: Light-water reactors, SMRs, molten-salt, fast reactors, thorium fuel cycles, and fuel supply. Caveat: whether fission counts as renewable is contested; its inclusion here follows the requester's scope.

subtopics.title: Nuclear fusion
subtopics.scope: Magnetic confinement (tokamaks, stellarators) and inertial confinement (laser ignition), plus fusion-fuel cycles and commercialization outlook. Caveat: fully pre-commercial; net energy gain at commercial scale is unproven.

subtopics.title: Hydrogen: production, carriers, and fuel cells
subtopics.scope: Electrolysis, thermochemical and photothermal water splitting, natural gas reforming with carbon capture (blue hydrogen), storage, transport, and fuel cell applications. Caveat: blue hydrogen is fossil-based and contested as a non-fossil source; hydrogen is a carrier, not a primary source.

subtopics.title: Natural (geologic) hydrogen
subtopics.scope: Hydrogen accumulations from subsurface serpentinization and radiolysis; exploration, extraction, and resource estimates. Caveat: highly speculative; commercial resource existence is unproven.

subtopics.title: Ambient energy harvesting
subtopics.scope: Piezoelectric, thermoelectric, triboelectric, pyroelectric, RF and vibration harvesting for low-power devices. Caveat: micro-scale only; not a meaningful primary energy source at grid scale and may be contested as an energy source.

subtopics.title: Space-based solar power
subtopics.scope: Orbital solar collection and microwave or laser power beaming to Earth; launch economics and demonstrations. Caveat: pre-commercial and speculative.

subtopics.title: Radioisotope and nuclear battery sources
subtopics.scope: Radioisotope thermoelectric generators, betavoltaics, and tritium-based nuclear batteries. Caveat: niche, low-power, and contested as a 'renewable' or primary energy source.

subtopics.title: Energy storage: electrochemical, thermal, mechanical, and hydrogen
subtopics.scope: Lithium-ion, flow, solid-state, and sodium-ion batteries; thermal storage (sensible, latent, thermochemical); compressed air (CAES), gravity storage, and hydrogen/power-to-gas storage; superconducting magnetic and flywheel storage. Caveat: storage is an enabling system, not a primary source; solid-state and gravity storage are pre-commercial.

subtopics.title: Grid integration: smart grids, transmission, demand response, and sector coupling
subtopics.scope: Smart grid and HVDC transmission, demand response and virtual power plants, sector coupling and power-to-X pathways. Caveat: enabling infrastructure rather than a primary source; included under the broad scope.

subtopics.title: Metal fuels and other contested chemical energy candidates
subtopics.scope: Metal-fuel energy (iron, aluminium, zinc, silicon-based fuels) and other proposed chemical energy carriers or sources not covered elsewhere. Caveat: speculative and largely at laboratory or concept stage.

subtopics.title: Hydrogen-free and other alternative primary sources: cross-cutting assessment
subtopics.scope: Cross-cutting comparison of lifecycle emissions, land and material footprints, levelized costs, and policy classification (renewable vs. low-carbon vs. sustainable) across all technologies in this decomposition. Caveat: meta-level; draws on other subtopics' outputs.

omittedOnPurpose: Nothing deliberately omitted. Debated items (fission, blue hydrogen, biomass, large hydro, waste-to-energy, natural hydrogen, metal fuels, space solar, nuclear batteries, ambient harvesting, airborne wind, osmotic power, OTEC, superhot rock geothermal, algae, BECCS) are retained with caveats per requester scope. Non-energy-source items such as storage and grid integration are retained as enabling systems, not primary sources.
